Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.23.2
Updates to make platesolver cli callable with new NINA plate solve shim, SASproSolver.exe. Put that in place of the astap executable path and NINA will use SASpro to solve your images. You will have to copy paste the path to the exe as the file load button is hardcoded to look for astap.exe.

Bug fixes and updates in: WCS overlay, WIMI, file saving extensions, Curves, RGB tool -> LRGB tool, and more.
